stemMarkdown: Find the area (in square cm) of a sector of a circle of radius 14 cm subtending an angle of $120$ degrees at the centre. Use $\pi = 3.14159265$. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: A sector is the fraction $\dfrac{120}{360}$ of the whole circle: $\dfrac{120}{360} \times \pi \times 14^2 = 205.2507$ square cm.
